TRUST BOUNDARY

Privacy architecture

Imported files are read with browser File APIs, processed in a Web Worker, and exported with local Blob URLs. They are not transmitted.

No data pipeline

No analytics, account, OAuth, telemetry, remote fonts, runtime CDN or AI API.

Browser-enforced boundary

The CSP blocks outbound application connections with connect-src 'none'.

Know the limits

The browser downloads the app from its host. Extensions, a compromised device or modified host build remain outside the trust boundary. Verify checksums or self-host for higher assurance.
